payload.name: Capture emotional reactions alongside plans
payload.description: When a message contains both a feeling about a past event and future plans, extract the emotional reaction as a separate memory in addition to the plan.
content: During extraction, if a message contains both an emotional reaction to a past event and future plans, create separate candidates for each distinct durable fact.
Record the emotional reaction using memory kind 'state'; do not let a plan candidate subsume or replace the emotional reaction.

solves: Extraction captured only future plans from a message that also contained an explicit emotional reaction to feedback, leaving the reaction absent from memory. The failure mechanism is selecting one durable fact while ignoring a co-occurring emotional state. This rule applies whenever a single message expresses both an emotional response to a past event and future intentions, ensuring both are recorded as separate memories.
